CustomField.description: DEPRECATED (Phase 0 hotfix, D11): removed from the page layout and set read-only in FLS (Sciagen_Sample_Admin permission set). Stock enters only through Receipt or Transfer-In (SampleTransactionService); SampleTransactionService. landTransfersIn still sets it once, from Apex, at the moment a Transfer-In creates a brand-new lot for the recipient -- that's the field doing its one legitimate job, not an exception to the deprecation. Kept (not deleted) for historical/ reporting continuity on existing lots. notifyLargeAdjustments() no longer reads this field -- it now sums Receipt and Transfer-In transactions for the lot's quantity received to date instead, so a lot that has been topped up since it was created is judged against its real cumulative total, not a stale creation-time snapshot.
CustomField.label: Initial Quantity (packs)
